 Grammy[(\"Grammy DB<br/>MySQL Container\")]
 end

 ExtractGrammys[\"extract_grammys\"]
 end

 end

 end

 subgraph PREPARED_VALIDATION[\"Phase 4: Prepared Validation (Validación Preparada)\"]
 ValidatePrepared{\"GX: prepared_suite\"}
 end

 subgraph LOAD[\"Phase 5: Load (Carga)\"]
 Warehouse[(\"Data Warehouse<br/>MySQL DW\")]
 end

 HaltSpotify((Pipeline Halts))
 HaltGrammys((Pipeline Halts))
 HaltPrepared((Pipeline Halts))

 Spotify --> ExtractSpotify
 Grammy --> ExtractGrammys

 ExtractSpotify --> ValidateSpotify
 ExtractGrammys --> ValidateGrammys

 ValidateSpotify -->|Pass| Transform
 ValidateGrammys -->|Pass| Transform
 ValidateSpotify -.->|Fail| HaltSpotify
 ValidateGrammys -.->|Fail| HaltGrammys

 Transform --> ValidatePrepared
 ValidatePrepared -->|Pass| Warehouse
 ValidatePrepared -.->|Fail| HaltPrepared
